items.title: SBI Research, IDFC First expect rate hike in October as crude prices climb: Higher oil prices & inflation raise likelihood of policy tightening
items.description: Economists are gearing up for a potential rate hike from the central bank as soon as October, driven by escalating crude oil prices and ongoing food inflation concerns. The CEO of Axis Bank has raised alarms about the increasing risks of inflation. This shift in monetary policy timing comes as the Monetary Policy Committee prepares to evaluate interest rates in early October, reversing earlier predictions of stability.

items.title: First-time borrowers deepen credit reach: Credit uptake among eligible Indians more than doubled to 74% in March from 35% in 2017
items.description: Consumer durable loans are leading new-to-credit customers into institutional borrowing. Gold loans and microfinance also significantly contribute to this growing credit access. Institutional credit penetration is expanding beyond major cities into smaller locations. India's retail credit portfolio has seen substantial year-on-year expansion. This trend indicates increasing financial inclusion for many Indian citizens.

items.title: PNC Infratech shares tank 20%. What’s triggering the steep plunge on Tuesday?
items.description: PNC Infratech shares plunged after NHAI extended the debarment of Awadh Expressway to the company for three years, restricting its participation in key road project bids. The company is evaluating legal remedies, while its ongoing projects remain unaffected.

items.title: Vijay Kedia reveals multibagger playbook: How the superstar picks stocks using RISE strategy
items.description: Vijay Kedia’s investment approach is built as much around discipline as opportunity. He is willing to buy stocks after sharp declines but refuses to chase them when valuations move beyond his comfort zone. As mutual funds, family offices and other investors crowd into emerging businesses, Kedia is increasingly looking at SMEs, unlisted companies and startups for opportunities that offer attractive valuations and growth potential.

items.title: Angel One among 4 stocks closing over 2% above VWAP
items.description: On September 11, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 2% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Why is stock market rising today? 3 key factors driving Sensex and  Nifty rebound
items.description: On Tuesday morning, Indian stock markets experienced a remarkable surge, with both Sensex and Nifty recording impressive gains that significantly boosted market capitalization. Key players like HCL Tech and Infosys spearheaded this rally in technology stocks. In contrast, broader markets and certain banking shares faced slight downturns. Overall, the IT sector showcased outstanding performance compared to other industries throughout the trading session.

items.title: Infosys, HCLTech, TCS, other IT stocks soar up to 6%; Nifty IT rallies 5% as global AI slowdown calls boost sentiment
items.description: Indian IT stocks rallied up to 6% after calls from Anthropic and OpenAI leaders for a slower pace of AI development eased fears of disruption from AI. Infosys, HCLTech, LTIMindtree and Mphasis gained around 6%, while TCS and Tech Mahindra rose over 5%, pushing the Nifty IT index up about 5%.

items.title: CLSA hikes Sterlite Tech share price target by 47%; maintains Outperform call on stock that’s up 775% YTD
items.description: Sterlite Tech shares gained 2% after CLSA raised its target price by 47% to Rs 1,400, implying a 55.55% upside, while retaining its Outperform rating. The brokerage expects the company’s capacity to expand 50% by FY29, backed by Rs 3,000 crore of approved capex. Revenue is projected to reach Rs 20,000 crore, driven by AI data centres and hyperscalers.

items.title: BSE, Groww, other broking stocks in focus as SEBI proposes changes to CAS. What does it mean for investors?
items.description: BSE, Groww, Angel One and Motilal Oswal are in focus after Sebi proposed changes to the Closing Auction Session and expiry-day settlement methodology. Jefferies remains bearish on BSE but sees Groww as a better play on India’s equity market.

items.title: LIC Housing Finance among 5 F&O stocks with sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 11, five stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a notable increase in futures open interest, with the combined open interest rising by more than 5% compared with the previous trading session. Futures open interest represents the total number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. An increase in open interest indicates greater participation in the futures market, either through initiating new positions or increasing existing ones.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares rise 3% as lender shortlists CEO candidates. Why Bernstein, Nomura, others see up to 62% upside
items.description: HDFC Bank submitted two CEO candidates to the RBI, initiating the succession process. Brokerages maintain bullish calls for the stock, citing potential continuity and a cleaner slate. An internal candidate offers familiarity, while an external one could drive strategic reassessment. The bank's shares have underperformed significantly, showing oversold readings. Analysts maintain buy ratings with substantial upside potential from current levels.

items.title: PhysicsWallah among 5 Nifty500 stocks flashing bullish signals
items.description: On September 11, five stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level towards the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: Yes Bank among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On September 11, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, suggesting strengthening momentum in the price of the stock. This can indicate potential upward movement and may be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Pranav Constructions shares make strong D-Street debut, list at 33% premium over IPO price
items.description: The Rs 351.03-crore public issue was priced in the range of Rs 118–Rs 124 per share. At the upper end of the price band, the issue price stood at Rs 124 per share. Incorporated in 2003, Pranav Constructions Limited is a Mumbai-based real estate company focused primarily on redevelopment projects in the MCGM region, particularly the Western Suburbs.

items.title: Apana Logistics shares to list today: Check GMP and other key details
items.description: The Rs 34.14 crore IPO was a fixed-price issue comprising an entirely fresh issue of 56.90 lakh shares. The company had fixed the IPO price at Rs 60 per share.

items.title: Tata Group stocks: TCS, Tata Motors, Tata Chemicals rally up to 20% as RBI rejects Tata Sons’ CoR surrender; Tata Sons IPO back in spotlight
items.description: In a significant move, the Reserve Bank of India has denied Tata Sons' proposal to relinquish its registration, bringing the spotlight back to the possibility of a public offering for the holding company. After the announcement on September 11, many Tata Group stocks saw a considerable uptick. The expected IPO now stands at an impressive valuation between Rs 9-12 lakh crore.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 6 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, six stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on September 11, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Bourses and brokers may win from India’s proposed auction revamp
items.description: India's securities regulator is considering revisions to the closing auction system, intending to enhance stability in end-of-day trading prices and curb market volatility. While stock exchanges and brokers are likely to reap benefits from these regulatory changes, market makers may encounter stricter constraints on their trading operations. The regulator is currently inviting feedback regarding these proposed adjustments.
